    Bounds on pieces #

    Paths of nonzero value in a finite ray category have bounded length (exists_length_bound). So chains in a piece of the cover and in its quotients are bounded (runB_piece, runB_quot), and the underlying graphs have bounded degree (card_adj_le).

    source
    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.exists_length_bound {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] :
    ∃ (N : ℕ), ∀ (x y : P) (l : List (RayQuiver.quiver P).A) (h : FinQuiver.PathFrom x l y), RayQuiver.pathMor l x y h ≠ 0 → l.length < N

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.RayCat.chain_path {P : Type} [CategoryTheory.Category.{0, 0} P] [CategoryTheory.Limits.HasZeroMorphisms P] [IsRayCategory P] [Fintype P] [DecidableEq P] {x₀ : P} {S : Finset (Cover x₀)} {k : Type u} [Field k] (hpar : ParEq S) (hacyc : ∀ (i : (pieceQuiver S).V) (l : List (pieceQuiver S).A), l ≠ [] → ¬FinQuiver.PathFrom i l i) {x : ℕ → (pieceQuiver S).V} {c : ℕ → PieceAlg k S} {s t : ℕ} {w : PieceAlg k S} (h : (pieceDirData hacyc).IsChain x c s t w) (hne : ∀ (i : ℕ), s ≤ i → i < t → x i ≠ x (i + 1)) :
    pev (x t) * w * pev (x s) = 0 ∨ ∃ (l : List (pieceQuiver S).A), FinQuiver.PathFrom (x s) l (x t) ∧ s ≤ t ∧ t - s ≤ l.length
